summary: This is a pricing supplement filed under Rule 424(b)(5) for a registered offering of $422,000 aggregate principal amount of Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due June 30, 2032, issued by Jefferies Financial Group Inc. The notes are linked to the worst-performing of the VanEck Semiconductor ETF and the S&P 500 Index. The terms include quarterly contingent coupon payments of $37.50 per note and automatic call features. The filing is a routine structured note takedown under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation transaction. No deal terms (price per share, premium, etc.) are applicable.
